App Link: http://goo.gl/7YaNW

Category:["Games", "Entertainment", "Role Playing", "Simulation"]

Create and care for your very own zoo! Collect hundreds of animals and mix and match them to build the most beautiful zoo. 
The best #1 FREE zoo game just got better!

By Pocket Gems, the makers of #1 free games like Tap Zoo Classic, Tap Pet Hotel, Tap Pet Shop, Tap Paradise Cove, Zombie Takeover and many more. 

Loaded with fun free features!
- Collect HUNDREDS of different ANIMALS
- Travel to Africa with an all new SAFARI zoo!
- CROSSBREED animals to discover new EXOTIC animals
- Mix 3 animals to create crazy new species with ANIMAL MIXING
- DECORATE your zoo with stores, restaurants, trees and attractions!
- Expand your tiny zoo into a world class animal resort
- Play with FRIENDS for more fun
- Visit your NEIGHBORS and show them that you can build the best zoo
- Play for free, yes FREE, forever
